title: Flower catalogues
description: The flower and foliage varieties you offer, with season and indicative price. They appear on the listing page once a moderator has checked them.

list.emptyBody: A catalogue is a list of varieties with a photo, season, colours and an indicative price. Planners see it on the listing page.
list.noFloralTitle: Catalogues are for florists and decoration
list.noFloralBody: Add one of the categories "Florists" or "Decoration and styling" to a listing, then come back here.
list.name: Catalogue name

editor.pendingBody: A moderator is checking the changes. Until then the public version stays unchanged.
editor.pendingNew: A moderator is checking this catalogue. It becomes public once approved.
editor.rejectedTitle: The last submission was not approved
editor.unsentBody: Nothing you change here is public until you send the catalogue for checking and a moderator approves it.
editor.emptyBody: Add the first variety: name, photo, season, colours and, if you know it, the indicative price.
editor.retireBody: It disappears from the listing page. Plans that already use its varieties keep their copies.
editor.readOnly: The business cannot change content right now. See the notice above.

item.imageKeep: The current photo stays unless you upload another.
item.seasonHint: Tick the months you usually have it. Nothing ticked = season unknown.
item.priceHint: Leave empty if you will not or cannot give a price — it shows as "unknown".
item.notesHint: For example stem length or minimum order.

public.title: Flower catalogue
public.lead: Varieties published by the business and checked by a moderator. Prices are indicative, not a quote.

errors.price: Write the price in figures, for example 12 or 12.50.
errors.priceZero: The price cannot be zero. Leave the field empty if you do not know it.
errors.imageNotYours: Upload the photo again: the file does not belong to the business.
errors.tooManyItems: A catalogue can have at most {max} varieties.
errors.tooManyCatalogues: A business can have at most {max} catalogues. Withdraw one to add another.
errors.empty: Add at least one variety before sending the catalogue.
errors.nothingToSubmit: You have nothing new to send.
errors.notFloral: Choose a listing in the Florists or Decoration and styling category.
